header_evidence.explanation: The opening heading occurs once in the extracted text. It names the term (third) but NOT the subject: the body has no 'SUBJECT:' line and no 'CLASS:' line, and the upper-case word 'PHYSICS' does not occur. 'physics' occurs 10 times case-insensitively, all in 'Reading Assignment' lines citing the textbook 'New school physics'. The page header and footer (not part of the body text the importer reads, so they cannot serve as header_text) read 'WKLAS/SS1/3rd term/Physics' followed by 'Page 14', which names Physics, class SS1 and the 3rd Term. The 10-week scheme and teaching corroborate Physics: electric circuit, resistors and cells in series and parallel, electrical energy and power, fuse, atomic structure, crystal structure of matter, surface tension, capillarity, elasticity, energy stored in an elastic material. canonical_subject 'Physics' therefore rests on the page header/footer, the teaching content and the manifest assignment, not on a body heading, and the filename was not used as evidence. Because the heading differs from the canonical name, a source_alias is declared and its approval is left to the owner.
